reviews.review:
Fun but somewhat janky and poorly optimized.

With an i7 2070 super I had to turn it down to 1440 to maintain 60 fps in some areas. 

Heavy Dark Souls vibe but with guns, LOTS OF GUNS. There is also melee but I dont use it much so I cant really speak to its validity as a method to rely on. Dodging is of course critical and thus far I have seen no mechanics for blocking. 

I would recommend this game to any fan of the souls formula with the idea that you should get it on a sale. The game can be very punishing but at the same time rewarding if you explore. Shortcuts seem plentiful as well. 

At full price I would say no buy but on a sale it is worth a thumbs up.

Play Remnant: From the Ashes if you want shooty Souls.

This game doesnt work. You have never enough ammo, enemies just teleport into the map, combat is more like Dark Souls where you have to dodge every attack but that leaves pretty much no time for shooting and hitboxes and/or immunity frames are scuffed.
Also its a dark scifi world but all the weapons are just recolored 2021 real life guns so you shoot weird energy alien beings with an AK47.

I love this game. The gameplay is very much reminiscent of dark souls (but with guns) with a visual aesthetic matching code vein. There's plenty of upgradeable loot, armor to aquire, and skills to obtain. I think there's close to 100 weapons in all, split into 5 catagories. The gameplay focuses on gunfire, but there's also a melee/dodge system. I highly recommend this if your into the souls series, or the division. Those are the two fanbases I would say this game tailors to
